result.description:
Aircraft Maintenance Engineer (Leading Hand)

Are you passionate about aircraft maintenance and ready to soar to new heights in your career? Look no further! We are currently seeking a skilled Aircraft Maintenance Engineer (Leading Hand) to join our Cairns based team and contribute to the safety and efficiency of our clients’ aircraft.

At Global Aircraft Services Pty Ltd, we are committed to upholding the highest standards of aircraft maintenance in accordance with Australian regulations. As an Aircraft Maintenance Engineer (Leading Hand), you will play a crucial role in ensuring the airworthiness of our clients’ aircraft, keeping them in optimal condition.

Responsibilities:
- Oversee the conduct of routine inspections, maintenance, and repairs on aircraft systems, adhering to Australian Civil Aviation Safety Authority (CASA) regulations.
- Assist our engineering team with diagnosis and troubleshooting of mechanical and electrical issues, utilizing your expertise and knowledge of Australian aviation standards.
- Plan and implement scheduled maintenance tasks by our engineering team, including engine checks, avionics inspections, and hydraulic system servicing.
- Manage our engineering team to ensure compliance with CASA regulations and timely completion of maintenance tasks.
- Maintain accurate records of all maintenance activities by our engineering team, including repairs, inspections, and parts used, in accordance with Australian aviation industry requirements.

Requirements:
- Hold an Australian Certificate IV in Aeroskills or equivalent qualification.
- Minimum of 4 years of experience in aircraft maintenance, preferably within the Australian aviation industry or foreign aviation industry with similar regulatory standards.
- In-depth knowledge of Australian aviation regulations, including CASA regulations and maintenance practices.
- Proficiency in using specialized tools and equipment for aircraft maintenance and repairs.
- Strong problem-solving skills and meticulous attention to detail.
- Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent communication, interpersonal and leadership skills.

Join our team and be part of an organization that prioritizes safety, compliance, and excellence in aircraft maintenance. We offer a competitive salary range of $80,000 per annum plus depending on skills and experience plus comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for professional growth within the Australian aviation industry.

To apply, please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and qualifications.

This advertisement was first published on 06 July 2026
Applications and expressions of interest close on 08 August 2026
result.title: Aircraft Maintenance Engineer (Leading Hand)

result.description:
Grounded Construction Group is currently looking to recruit an experienced and qualified Road Roller Operator to join their team in Muchea WA.


The Road Roller Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of road rollers to compact soil, gravel, asphalt and other construction materials for roads, hardstands, building platforms and civil infrastructure works. The role is responsible for achieving specified compaction standards while maintaining compliance with company, client and legislative requirements.

The successful candidate will need to undertake and possess:

-  Operate road rollers safely and efficiently to compact soil, gravel, crushed rock, asphalt and other construction materials. 
-  Achieve specified compaction standards for roads, hardstands, building pads, foundations and civil infrastructure. 
-  Compact fill layers in accordance with project specifications and engineering requirements. 
-  Perform rolling operations for pavement construction, roadworks, drainage and site preparation activities. 
-  Read and work from construction drawings, survey pegs, compaction specifications and supervisor instructions. 
-  Monitor rolling patterns and identify areas requiring additional compaction. 
-  Coordinate safely with graders, excavators, loaders and other mobile plant during earthworks operations. 
-  Conduct daily pre-start inspections and complete required plant inspection documentation. 
-  Monitor equipment performance and report faults or maintenance requirements promptly. 
-  Carry out routine servicing, lubrication and minor maintenance within competency limits. 
-  Participate in pre-start meetings, toolbox meetings and safety interactions. 
-  Operate safely around personnel, mobile plant, underground services and fixed infrastructure. 
-  Maintain compliance with Grounded, client and statutory safety requirements. 
-  Complete required plant logs, inspection records and production documentation accurately. 
-  Assist with site establishment and other construction activities where required. 
-  Maintain housekeeping standards around work areas and equipment. 
-  Contribute to achieving project production, quality and safety objectives. 

Skills and Abilities:
-  Relevant qualification equivalent to AQF Certificate II or Certificate III, or equivalent industry experience. 
-  Minimum one (1) year relevant experience operating road rollers. 
-  Current Driver’s Licence (HR – MC Role Dependant) 
-  Operating SOA 
-  Operating VOC (2 years validity)


Salary range is $75,000 - $85,000pa commensurate with experience.

Fulltime Position available

Applications open on 20th July 2026 and closes on 20th August 2026

If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted
result.title: Road Roller Operator

result.description:
Who we are?

Al Aseel is 22 years young, developed upon our love for food, service, family, sharing and fun.
The Al Aseel group continues to evolve and grow, with 9 Al Aseel restaurants in NSW. In conjunction with this, a production kitchen in Greenacre with an incredible catering offering for corporate and private events - servicing clients in the retail, airline and government industries.

Why work with Al Aseel?

The current focus is building quality teams to help drive the growth and take Al Aseel to the next level, and pioneer the Al Aseel brand to share the delicacy of the Lebanese cuisine and hospitality without borders, with a focus on operational excellence. Join a growing, successful business and be a part of the next stage of our adventure.

The Role

We are recruiting now for an experienced and passionate Cooks and Chefs to assist the Al Aseel team in running day to day activities of the kitchen.

The position is full time with an attractive salary package that also offers good work and life balance opportunities.

Your key duties and responsibilities will be, but are not limited to:

•	Prepare and cook menu items to meet quality standards, presentation, and timing requirements
•	Collaborate with the head chef and sous-chefs on menu development, seasonal 
•	Monitor food quality, taste, texture, and temperature; adjust recipes as needed
•	Supervise, train, and mentor junior kitchen staff, including cooks, prep cooks, and line cooks
•	Maintain accurate inventory of ingredients and supplies; assist with ordering and receiving
•	Manage stock levels, rotate ingredients, and minimize waste through efficient prep and storage
•	Monitor and enforce food safety and hygiene practices; ensure compliance with health codes and HACCP guidelines
•	Ensure proper food handling, storage, labeling, and allergen management; accommodate dietary restrictions
•	Monitor food costs and portion sizes to support budget goals; suggest cost-saving measures without compromising quality
•	Assist with menu costing, recipe costing, and profitability analysis
•	Support catering events, buffets, and offsite functions as needed; adapt menus for event specifications

Qualifications & Skills: 

•	Proven experience as a cook, line cook, or chef; 2+ years preferred for higher-level roles
•	Comprehensive knowledge of cooking techniques, equipment, and food safety standards
•	Strong knife skills, taste and aroma sensitivity, and attention to detail
•	Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced kitchen
•	Leadership, communication, and teamwork skills
•	Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed
•	Culinary degree or relevant certification preferred (not always required)
